projects.title: THIS INDEX
projects.description: The site you are looking at: a loud, responsive home for work, code, experiments, and the occasional useful mistake.
projects.context: Most portfolios make the work fight through polish, panels, and presentation. This one needed to feel more like a poster you can use.
projects.move: Make navigation the visual language: enormous type, hard rules, numbered links, one acid marker, and nothing ornamental that cannot earn its space.
projects.outcome: A responsive single-page index with durable internal routes, locally curated content, and a deliberately small visual vocabulary.

projects.title: LIGHTHOUSE CHECKER
projects.description: A small public tool for keeping web performance checks close at hand.
projects.context: Performance checks are useful. Performance-checking workflows are often buried beneath more ceremony than the task needs.
projects.move: Keep the utility focused and keep the implementation public, so the source is as easy to inspect as the idea is to understand.
projects.outcome: A compact artifact in the public code archive. The repository is the launch page, changelog, and record of the experiment.

projects.title: ITADW
projects.description: An early code experiment preserved with its attempts and useful mistakes intact.
projects.context: Some projects begin as a question rather than a brief. The useful part is often the attempt, not a manufactured success story.
projects.move: Keep the scope small, publish the source, and let the artifact remain open-ended rather than rewriting it as something more finished.
projects.outcome: A public-code experiment preserved as part of the wider archive: available to inspect, fork, or simply leave as evidence of the work.
